$comment: FORMS MODULE (pack: forms — D10, the OPTIONAL pack) — targets bizapps-forms' REAL shapes (migrations/B202606281200, schema __mj_BizAppsForms, entity prefix 'MJ_BizApps_Forms: '). Slice v1: one post-conference attendee survey, distributed per conference year, answered by attendees with theta-driven satisfaction — so 'NPS predicts renewal' demos work because both share the engagement cause.

survey.name: Post-Conference Attendee Survey
survey.description: Sent to all attendees the day after the ICF Annual Conference closes.

questions.prompt: How likely are you to recommend the ICF Annual Conference to a colleague?
How would you rate your overall conference experience?
Do you plan to attend next year's conference?

application.name: Membership Application
application.description: Public intake form on the ICF website — prospective members apply here.
application.$note: the ANONYMOUS story (bizapps-forms' flagship feature): applicants are NOT members — responses carry MemberNumber null + AnonymousSessionID, identity lives only in answer text (no Person rows). Names come from the cleared banks via personName streams.

questions.prompt: Tell us about your operation or interest in cheese

volume.$note: modest public-intake trickle — ESTIMATE; partials run higher than the member survey (anonymous funnels leak more)

operationTemplates: Small {segment} operation in {toponym}; looking to connect with the wider community.
Family-run for two generations — hoping the federation can help us with food-safety guidance.
Just getting started as a {segment} and want access to the courses and the annual conference.
We run a farmers-market stall and are exploring wholesale; joining for the standards resources.
Longtime home cheesemaker turning professional; interested in certification down the road.

response.$note: SOURCED 2026-07-16 (confidence: medium): Explori puts conference/corporate-event survey response at 10-20%, event-industry consensus 20-30% typical, paid conferences 30-40% aspirational (explori.com 'what is a good post-event survey response rate'; formbricks.com; formgrid.com). Members-only paid conference justifies the upper band: 28% +/-8. Was 35% ESTIMATE - lowered per research.
response.$partialNote: share of responses that start but never submit (Status Partial, first answer only) — real funnels leak

nps.$source: SOURCED 2026-07-16 (confidence: high): Explori benchmark across thousands of events puts conference-attendee NPS at +35.4 (explori.com/blog/nps_for_events; medium.com/@erikfabian NPS-for-events; retently.com benchmarks: 20-40 average, 30-50 excellent for B2B events). The old 7.2 mean computed to NPS ~ -10 - materially wrong; a mean of ~8.3 yields computed NPS ~ +25-40.

answers.$note: satisfaction rides the same hidden engagement dial as renewal — correlations between NPS and retention EMERGE from the shared cause, never painted on
